scope: Read-only independent audit of the exact-SHA M144r2 VCS/DC seals, fresh production VCS/DC replay, separately written protocol attacks, and mapped-DDC evidence.

score.disposition: GO for the narrow non-wrapping, reset-atomic standalone controller VCS result and its 3 ns flattened logic-only DC result. CONDITIONAL NO-GO for a reusable long-lived or independently reset engine interface until reset-epoch and sequence-wrap contracts are closed. NO-GO for engine, SRAM, matched-frequency, physical, power, energy or system-speedup claims.

independent_protocol_hammer.wrap_method: Backdoor force/deposit initialized the otherwise reachable pre-wrap wrapper/lower allocation and completion sequence state to 0xfffffffe; three subsequent allocations and the barrier used only normal production handshakes and combinational logic.

independent_dc_replay.qor_report_difference_from_seal: report timestamp and 0.01 s compile-runtime noise only

findings.title: Reset can recreate an endpoint identity and silently consume a pre-reset stale completion
findings.evidence: A PWP request for bank 0, tag 0x6000, sequence 0 was accepted, rst_core reset the wrapper, the same bank/tag/sequence identity was allocated after reset, and the old completion was then accepted with protocol_error remaining zero and the new bank advancing to WAIT_CORRECTION.
findings.impact: The standalone wrapper is not epoch-safe if the endpoint engine can retain or return a response across the controller reset boundary.
findings.qualification: This is harmless only under a frozen and proven atomic reset/flush contract that destroys all endpoint requests and responses before the wrapper resumes service.
findings.required_fix: Carry a reset epoch in endpoint identity or add a reset/flush request-acknowledgement gate that blocks new service until old completions are impossible.

findings.title: Unsigned 32-bit ordering and barrier drainage fail at sequence wrap
findings.evidence: From reachable pre-wrap state 0xfffffffe, three normal allocations receive fffffffe, ffffffff and 00000000. The lower unsigned oldest selector chooses sequence zero ahead of fffffffe, and a fence of zero sees next_completion=fffffffe as drained, offering commit before any of the three jobs completes.
findings.impact: A sufficiently long reset epoch can reorder service and prematurely release a barrier without protocol_error.
findings.qualification: The heldout workload is far below 2^32 allocations; the defect becomes out of scope if a checked workload/reset contract proves fewer than 2^32 allocations and prevents wrap.
findings.required_fix: Prefer fail-closed saturation before 0xffffffff allocation and freeze the maximum allocations per reset, or implement epoch-qualified modular half-range comparison consistently in both oldest selection and barrier drainage.

findings.title: The production VCS seal does not directly cover most newly requested boundary attacks
findings.evidence: The production seal has five jobs and three protocol attacks. Exact 384-row extent, early/late/skip/tag row faults, same-edge barrier/allocation, wrong/duplicate commit, exact one-cycle completion, reset alias and wrap were exercised only by this independent hammer.
findings.required_fix: Adopt the independently demonstrated normal-boundary tests into the production exact-SHA TB/SVA and add explicit negative properties for overflow and reset disposition.

findings.title: No RTL-to-mapped-netlist Formality seal is admitted
findings.evidence: Exact VCS, mapped Verilog, SDC, DDC and SVF exist, and the DDC reopens cleanly, but no completed M144r2 Formality receipt was provided in the reviewed scope.
findings.required_fix: Run exact-SHA RTL-to-final-mapped-netlist Formality before treating the DC netlist as functionally admitted.

findings.title: The 3 ns DC closure is razor-thin and prephysical
findings.evidence: The independently reproduced critical path is 77 logic levels from lower/bank_sequence_q_reg[1][0] to correction_accept, 2.5481 ns with only +0.0019 ns setup slack; hold is reported +0.0000 ns. Clock is ideal, wireload is ZeroWireload and routing is absent.
findings.required_fix: Pipeline or partition the sequence/correction-accept cone, then close matched-frequency PT with propagated clock and realistic output loads before citing Fmax.

findings.title: The synthesized cut is controller-only and macro/power incomplete
findings.evidence: The 3902.472014 um2 result has 742 ports and zero macros. Endpoint arithmetic, descriptor/result SRAM, activity power, clock tree and routing are absent.
findings.required_fix: Keep this as controller logic-only evidence; integrate or model bounded SRAM and endpoint engines, then obtain PT/PTPX or an explicitly calibrated cycle/energy model for any performance claim.

admitted: exact-SHA M144r2 production VCS counts and nonzero SVA covers
independent exact-row, sequence, completion, endpoint, barrier, fence and commit behavior away from reset alias and sequence wrap
flattened TSMC28 standard-cell controller logic-only area and ideal-clock ZeroWireload timing at 3 ns
mapped DDC readability, cell/area identity and timing status
not_admitted: reset-epoch safety without atomic endpoint flush
correct operation across 32-bit sequence wrap without a workload bound
descriptor or result SRAM macro area, latency or energy
paper PPA readiness, DATE headline or best-paper readiness
